turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, how may I assist you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hey, I would like to pay my subscription fee to make sure I keep it active

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Do you want to check the subscription due amount?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yea, that would help too

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Or is this about just paying the bill.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I want to pay, but I don't know the amount either, so I will pay whatever is needed

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Ok, i can help you with that

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: What is your name or account id?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Account ID: XASS9FV3NR

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: Account has been pulled up for XASS9FV3NR.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Actually, I think I need your full name to pay the bill anyway

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: And also the Order ID

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: David

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Williams

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: David is the first name

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: Identity verification in progress ...

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: OK, you have been verified

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You didn't know how much was due, so let me check that for you

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: Querying the system for subscription status ...

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sounds like you need to pay $55

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: Details of 55 have been entered.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Ok, that sounds reasonable

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I was afraid it might be hundreds

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Well, a full bill would still only be $99

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Do you have a credit card available?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Uhh, sure

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: Account has been updated with renew subscription.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Wonderful, I used that credit card to update your account

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You should be active for another year now

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Wonderful

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: that was easy enough

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Yup, is there anything else I can help you with?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, that's it

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Ok, have a great day!
